paragraphs: Basemap describes itself as an expert in transport software and data for accurate travel analysis. Its main product, TRACC, analyses travel times, optimises transit routes, and identifies accessibility gaps to key destinations. Government departments, city planners, transport operators, and consultants are named as the people who rely on those products.

Alongside the software, the company produces public transport timetables, average speed, and speed limit data for government agencies. DataCutter handles data management, with extraction tailored to a specific project. An electric vehicle routing product plans routes and forecasts energy consumption using more than 12 factors. Highways Analyst covers traffic data visualisation and analysis.

The case studies list the UK Department for Transport, which has been developing and publishing journey time statistics for over 10 years. Another describes OC Transpo, the municipal transit provider in Ottawa, starting to use TRACC for route and level of service planning. Leicestershire Tri-Service Fire and Rescue is described using Basemap speed datasets in its command and control system. An NHS case study covers a travel time analysis spanning emergency vehicles and private and public transport.

quote.text: Basemap produces accurate public transport timetables, average speed, and speed limit data for government agencies.
